title: Universal H0 splitting factorization data
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and P a cochain complex of R-modules with P^(-1)=0 and P^0,P^1 finite projective. Suppose that for every commutative R-algebra B, H^0(P tensor_R B) is isomorphic to B. Then there are an R-module I and R-linear maps e:P^0 -> I, p:I -> P^1, r:I -> P^0 and q:P^1 -> I such that d^0=e p, r e=id_I, and p q=id_I, with products in categorical (left-to-right) order.

source.place: Tags 00O0 and 00NX, local matrix splitting and projective cokernel

proof.text: By new-universal-h0-cokernel-local-free the quotient Q=P^1/im(d^0) is free at all primes. P^1 is finitely presented by finite projectivity, and the image of P^0 is finitely generated. Module.finitePresentation_of_surjective makes Q finitely presented. Module.projective_of_localization_maximal makes Q projective, since free localizations are projective.

Split the quotient map pi:P^1 -> Q using projective_lifting_property, with section t. The map id-t pi lands in I=im(d^0), defining q:P^1 -> I. On I, pi=0, so q restricts to the identity. The inclusion p:I -> P^1 and q exhibit I as a direct summand of the projective module P^1. Apply Projective.of_split to make I projective.

Take e to be the range restriction of d^0. This is surjective, so projective_lifting_property for the projective image I supplies r with r e=id_I. The factorization d^0=e p is definitional and p q=id_I is the earlier restriction calculation. All constructions occur within the existential theorem proof; no definition chooses data from an unproved existence theorem.

statement_change.what: The equation e r=id_(P^0) is false: take R=Z and the complex R concentrated in degree zero. The differential is zero but the two claimed retractions would imply id_R=e r=e(p q)r=(e p)q r=0. Reverse the first splitting equation to r e=id_I, the section equation for the surjection onto the image. The original algebraic contradiction is also certified in scratchpad/Counterexample.lean. This is an intermediate statement correction, not a target change.
